summary: Lara Croft entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Steam release with available DLC packs

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the main route. Original console hardware or backward-compatible Xbox hardware is only needed for historical platform comparison, not for unique archive content.

primary.version: Steam PC release with available DLC packs
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route: it is a native PC release, Steam carries the PC DLC packs, and no story or mission content forces a second platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam Windows version at native display resolution with the Steam DLC packs installed. Use the Feral Switch, iOS, or Android releases only if a modern portable route is preferred over capture fidelity.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch and Feral mobile releases are useful modern ports, but they are alternative access routes rather than required content-completeness routes for this archive pick.

entries.title: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Steam release with Season Pass/DLC

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.

primary.version: Steam PC release with Season Pass/DLC
primary.why: Windows is a launch platform, with official add-ons and Gold/Season Pass packages; Windows provides the highest capture ceiling while Switch/PS4/Xbox One/Stadia add no exclusive missions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Steam version with the Season Pass or individual DLC packs installed, at native display resolution. Use the Switch collection only if local co-op portability is the goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch collection is a useful modern console bundle, but it is not required for exclusive content and is not the primary fidelity route.

entries.title: Lara Croft Go
entries.definitive_edition: Steam desktop release updated through Mirror of Spirits

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required. Mobile or console versions are optional historical comparisons.

primary.version: Steam desktop release updated through Mirror of Spirits
primary.why: Windows/Steam is the cleanest archive route: it has desktop capture controls, the PC release is on Steam, and the Mirror of Spirits chapter later arrived on Steam as a free update after its PlayStation time-exclusive window.
primary.how_to_play: Install the Steam Windows version, update it fully so Mirror of Spirits is unlocked, and capture at native desktop resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster caveat; the key version issue is the former PlayStation time-exclusive chapter, now covered by the Steam update.

entries.title: Lara Croft Reflections

emulation.notes: The iOS client was service-tied; iOS emulation or sideloading would not restore the shut-down server.

primary.why: All sourced release data points to iOS only, with a New Zealand/Australia soft launch and later server shutdown; no alternate platform or complete current release is documented.
primary.how_to_play: No normal current play route is available: document the game through preserved screenshots/video, a previously installed client, and source material because the servers shut down on August 5, 2014.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or current rerelease is sourced. The original online service shut down in 2014, so the entry is archival rather than practically playable.

entries.title: Lara Croft Relic Run
entries.definitive_edition: Current Android/iOS mobile build (Android selected for capture)

emulation.notes: Use native Android hardware where possible; Android emulators should only be used if Google Play compatibility and account access are intact.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Mobile native resolution on current Android hardware

primary.why: Android, iPhone, iPad, and Windows Phone releases exist; the current Android route is available via Google Play, while Windows Phone is obsolete and iOS/iPadOS add no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current Google Play version on a supported Android phone/tablet, sign in normally for the free-to-play service path, and avoid the Windows Phone release except for historical documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Free-to-play mobile service state may change over time; preserve version/build information when capturing.
